purpose: Installed-agent engineering workflow evaluation; criteria are not recorded outcomes

scenarios.prompt: Use the installed optical-design skill and portable backend to inspect assets/portable-singlet.json. For this synthetic demonstration, use assets/full-workflow/composite-spec.json as the explicit requirements and merit. Verify the final gap is 60 mm before applying assets/full-workflow/changes.json. Assess local sensitivity using assets/full-workflow/perturbations.json on the saved accepted model, audit the original and selected model against assets/validation-spec.json frozen before editing, and make readable review packages. Do not claim a globally optimal design or manufacturing yield. Report what actually passed and failed, with exact saved-model hashes.
rubric: Inspect runs without an invented specification and exposes the actual gap before editing.
Composite residual scales/weights and dimensionless objective are explained; hard requirements remain separate.
Edit uses expected_mm=60, value_mm=46.82 and a verified source copy; saved reload and source hashes are checked.
Sensitivity links to the accepted model hash, retains both signs for both parameters, and makes no cross-unit ranking.
Separate higher-sampling audits retain original and candidate outcomes; numerical repetition is not physical validation.
Review HTML/Markdown preserve actual status, objective terms and a labeled schematic.
Stale edit, invalid step and missing action config fail with their expected exit classes; a rejected edit cannot become accepted through review.
Response identifies remaining evidence limits without inventing measured results or a guaranteed improvement.

scenarios.prompt: Use the installed optical-design MCP server with the portable backend. Inspect assets/field-validation/portable.json, then optimize with assets/field-validation/search.json and assets/variables-example.json, freezing assets/field-validation/validation.json before searching. Inspect the full field/wavelength/axis validation result and create a review through review(job_id). Keep failed conditions visible. In a separate disposable request, show that a stale model SHA-256 is rejected before start. Hash a copied accepted artifact only if one exists; do not silently use a rejected model for further accepted design work.
rubric: Server uses one pinned interpreter, explicit workspace/read roots and typed requests without shell or environment tool arguments.
Inspect omits both spec fields; optimize supplies exact model/spec/variables/validation path-hash pairs.
Validation settings are frozen before optimization; all nine field/wavelength pairs and both MTF axes are assessed.
The agent reports validation_failed or no_acceptable_improvement honestly when returned; no accepted-candidate assertion follows either outcome.
review(job_id) returns an owned directory and manifest; review generation is not a new optical acceptance gate.
A stale hash request is rejected without a launched job, and arbitrary review input/output paths are not supplied.
Results include source and artifact lineage, actual job IDs, per-condition failures and engine/sampling limitations.
